## Perf sprint + CJK Typst fix + terminal UX

Builds on **0.1.26**. Same-day measure-and-fix for common-path memory, progressive Typst paint, and Chinese preview.

### CJK / Typst fonts (critical)
- **Root cause** — metadata-only `DOCUMENT_FONTS` advertised full-Unicode coverage on every system face, so Typst picked Latin/emoji fonts for 中文 (tofu / wrong glyphs).
- **Fix** — Latin-ish coverage for ordinary faces; real `FontInfo::iter` cmap only for CJK/emoji-named faces (cached per file). Verified under Xvfb: loads `NotoSansCJK`, unit test `chinese_text_selects_a_real_cjk_face`.

### Markdown / preview memory
- **`FULL_PARSE_LIMIT`** — 2 MB → **512 KB** (mdast walk no longer dominates ~1 MB docs).
- **Preview prepare** — `normalize_tab_containers` + GFM hard breaks stream into one String (`prepare_preview_markdown`); no `Vec<&str>` in `apply_gfm_breaks`.
- **Custom nodes** — stop double-storing tab source; keep `(offset, len)` + single `.markdown(source)`.

### Typst live preview
- **File byte cache** — warm edits reuse image/include bytes (no re-read of `photo.png` every key).
- **Progressive sheets** — first dirty page paints early (`partial` Compiled); remaining pages follow.
- **Render budget banner** — if estimated pages/rasters/images exceed a soft budget, show an **inline** banner (not a modal); render only after **Render** / skip with **Skip**.

### Terminal UX
- **Shortcuts (VS Code)** — `Ctrl+\`` toggles on all platforms (not `Cmd+\``); `Ctrl+Shift+\`` = New Terminal; macOS also `Cmd+J` for panel toggle. Distinct chords — never one binding for both.
- **Follow-tail refresh** — output auto-scrolls while following; click focuses PTY; scroll-up pauses follow.

### Diagnostics
- Extended `MALGEL_PERF` marks (`typst_file_cache_hit`, `typst_compile_partial`, `cjk_or_emoji_files`, render-budget path).
